long_biography.plain_text:
Building Bain & Company Italy into an established strategic-advisory business gave Giovanni Cagnoli a vantage point across many branches of Italian industry. His work concentrated on corporate strategy, restructuring and turnaround programmes for companies, financial groups and industrial families. The role required him to combine operational diagnosis with the creation of durable value for shareholders.

Cagnoli studied business administration at Bocconi University before completing an MBA at MIT Sloan. He then spent almost three decades directing the consultancy's Italian growth and advising organisations through major change. That experience eventually provided the framework for a move from external advice to active ownership, where managerial expertise could be applied directly to the development of smaller businesses.

The sources positively document Cagnoli's personal role in founding and building Bain Italy and his later Carisma ownership, supporting broad Self-made.
